bio.text: Lezlye Zupkus represents the 89th General Assembly District, covering Prospect, Cheshire, Bethany and Waterbury, and was re-elected to a seventh two-year term in November 2024.
A Prospect resident, she is a graduate of Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in Florida.
She is state director of Best Buddies Connecticut and previously worked as director of development and volunteer services for Special Olympics Connecticut.
